test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 10 Dec, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is an ex-officio member of the National Commission for Allied and Healthcare Profession as provided in the National Commission for Allied and Healthcare Profession Act, 2021?

options.text: Minister of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India
Joint Secretary, Department of Legal Affairs, Ministry of Law and Justice
Secretary, Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India

solution:
The correct answer is __**Joint Secretary, Department of Legal Affairs, Ministry of Law and Justice**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Ex-officio members of the National Commission for Allied and Healthcare Profession include the Joint Secretary to the Government of India in the Department of Legal Affairs, Ministry of Law and Justice.
 
• The National Commission for Allied and Healthcare Professions (NCAHP) has been constituted under **National Commission for Allied and Healthcare Professions Act, 2021**.
 
• The National Commission for Allied and Healthcare Profession Act** regulates and maintains standards of education and services for allied and healthcare professionals**.
 
• It oversees the assessment of institutions and maintains both a Central Register and State Registers for these professionals.
 
• The Act aims to improve access, promote research and development, and encourage the adoption of the latest scientific advancements.
 
• NCAHP Act covers **56 Allied and Healthcare Professions** categorized under 10 broad recognized categories.
